purpose: Sample-timing test with a moving particle. Lone species-A particle from (0.5,5.0) with velocity (4.0,0.0), T=2, dt=0.01, no wall contact. A constant sample-time offset delta gives a mean x residual of about -4*delta (speed 4), so the mean residual bounds delta. Compares with r1/005 at speed 2.
